name: Key Remapper
description: Remap keys and automatically press selected keys at a percentage, on death, or on level completion.

main-section.name: Main Key Remap
main-section.description: Choose the key you press and the additional key sent by the mod.

enabled.name: Enable Key Remapper
enabled.description: Master switch for the main remap and every automatic key action.

output-key.name: Also Presses
output-key.description: The key that gets pressed (and released) together with the trigger key.

automatic-section.name: Automatic Key Presses
automatic-section.description: Configure keys that are pressed automatically during a level.

auto-percent-enabled.name: Press Key at Percent
auto-percent-enabled.description: Automatically press the selected key once when the target percentage is reached.

auto-percent.name: Target Percent
auto-percent.description: The level percentage that triggers the automatic key press.

auto-percent-key.name: Percent Key
auto-percent-key.description: The key pressed automatically when the target percentage is reached.

death-action-enabled.name: Press Key on Death
death-action-enabled.description: Press the selected key when the player dies after reaching the minimum percentage.

death-min-percent.name: Death Minimum Percent
death-min-percent.description: The death key only presses if the player reached at least this percentage.

death-action-key.name: Death Key
death-action-key.description: The key pressed when the player dies after reaching the minimum percentage.

complete-action-enabled.name: Press Key on Level Complete
complete-action-enabled.description: Automatically press the selected key once when the level is completed.

complete-action-key.name: Level Complete Key
complete-action-key.description: The key pressed automatically when the level is completed.

scope-section.name: Where It Works
scope-section.description: Choose where the main remap works. Automatic actions use Active in Levels.

scope-gameplay.name: Active in Levels
scope-gameplay.description: Allow the main remap and automatic actions while playing or practicing a level.

scope-editor.name: Active in Editor
scope-editor.description: Whether the remap works in the level editor.

scope-menus.name: Active in Menus
scope-menus.description: Whether the remap works everywhere else (menus, etc).

indicator-section.name: On-Screen Indicator
indicator-section.description: Control the remap indicator shown while playing a level.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Show the on-screen binding indicator while playing a level.

indicator-x.name: Indicator X
indicator-x.description: Horizontal position of the on-screen binding indicator, in levels.

indicator-y.name: Indicator Y
indicator-y.description: Vertical position of the on-screen binding indicator, in levels.
